title: Coordinator has no config_entry: HeatPumpOptimizerConfigEntry annotation under a done strict-typing row
claim: HeatPumpOptimizerCoordinator (the integration's one DataUpdateCoordinator subclass) declares no config_entry annotation anywhere in its in-package MRO, so its config_entry is the base's bare ConfigEntry | None, while strict-typing is done and its comment claims every attribute annotation is typed.
mechanism: The rule pages (strict-typing: 'use a typed config entry everywhere you get one'; runtime-data: 'A coordinator that gets the config entry should use the typed entry too: config_entry: MyConfigEntry', pylint home-assistant-coordinator-untyped-config-entry) ask for the class annotation. The coordinator receives the typed entry (coordinator.py:3514) and passes config_entry=entry (3536) but never re-annotates the attribute; coordinator.py:7022 then reads it through getattr(self, 'config_entry', None). The doc_claims census (qs_entry_param_bare) counts parameters, not this attribute. Fails D10-criteria Q2.

evidence.machine: macOS arm64, orchestrator box B3, venv-ci python 3.14.7
evidence.contention_note: shared box under heavy finder load (load1 147-260); counts are contention-immune

perturbation.change: --perturb coord (class annotation config_entry: HeatPumpOptimizerConfigEntry patched in memory) or --perturb row

metric_definition: coordinator_untyped_under_done_row: in-package DataUpdateCoordinator subclasses lacking a config_entry annotation naming the typed alias, while strict-typing is done
phenomenon_property: Every DataUpdateCoordinator subclass of the integration annotates config_entry with the typed entry alias.

null_control.note: the honest fix's shape moves the count to 0; entry-point parameters (12 sites) already read typed (entry_point_bare=0)

proposed_fix_scope: Add 'config_entry: HeatPumpOptimizerConfigEntry' to HeatPumpOptimizerCoordinator's class body (no newer HA API needed: config_entry= is already passed at the 2025.2.0 floor) and extend tests/doc_claims.py's census to the attribute.
